title: SAMA: Training-Free Consensus Ridge Tracking for Camera-Based Heart Rate on Five Public Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2611.28185v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is usually benchmarked by one heart rate per video, a figure that hides the short windows in which a tele-consultation would actually read the pulse. We present SAMA, a training-free estimator that (i) forms a quality-weighted consensus of POS and CHROM chrominance spectra, (ii) discounts frequencies occupied by pulse-free references derived from the same frames (frame motion, skin-mask geometry and background brightness), (iii) follows the heart rate through time with a Viterbi ridge under a random-walk prior, and (iv) returns a track-filtered, amplitude-normalised waveform with a per-window confidence. No parameter is learned and no dataset-specific tuning is used. On 218 recordings from 111 participants in five public datasets (UBFC-rPPG, PURE, SUMS, M3PD and a two-participant subset of MMPD), all processed with the same fixed face box and scored with a re-implementation of the rPPG-Toolbox protocol,

translated_title: SAMA：面向摄像头心率测量的免训练一致性脊线追踪方法及其在五个公开数据集上的验证
translated_abstract: 远程光电容积描记法（rPPG）通常以每个视频一个心率值作为基准，这一数字掩盖了远程问诊中真正能够读取脉搏的短时间窗口。我们提出了SAMA，这是一种免训练的估计器，它 (i) 对POS和CHROM色度光谱进行质量加权的一致性融合，(ii) 抑制由相同帧导出的无脉搏参考信号所占用的频率（包括帧运动、皮肤掩模几何形状和背景亮度），(iii) 在随机游走先验下使用维特比脊线追踪随时间变化的心率，并且 (iv) 返回经过轨迹滤波、幅度归一化的波形以及每个窗口的置信度。该方法不学习任何参数，也不使用针对特定数据集的调优。在来自111名参与者的五个公开数据集（UBFC-rPPG、PURE、SUMS、M3PD以及MMPD的双参与者子集）的218段录像上，所有数据均使用相同的固定人脸框处理，并使用重新实现的rPPG-Toolbox协议进行评分。
tldr: SAMA是一种免训练的远程光电容积描记法心率估计方法，通过POS与CHROM光谱的质量加权融合、无脉搏参考频率抑制以及维特比脊线追踪实现连续心率跟踪，在五个公开数据集的218段录像上无需任何参数学习或数据集特定调优即可输出带置信度的逐窗口心率波形。
